questions.title: Will the European Council reach a political agreement on the overall 2028-2034 Multiannual Financial Framework before January 1, 2027?
questions.background:
`EU Today: `[Costa Cuts Proposed EU Budget by €180 Billion as France Rejects Compromise](https://eutoday.net/costa-eu-budget-cuts-france-rejects-2028-2034/)

`{"format": "bot_tournament_question", "info": {"hash_id": "bb070e7fe0cf8570", "sheet_id": "133"}}`
questions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves as Yes if, before January 1, 2027, according to [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) the European Council reaches a political agreement on the EU's whole 2028-2034 Multiannual Financial Framework. 

In order to count, an agreement must include the overall spending ceiling.
